title: fix(spec): the 18.x action-block variant migration entry says element:button spells it danger, not destructive
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzjAFu9q3UWTLiMSuk9

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBKUxGsrA3itzdun1PSZn7o5)_

Fixes #27589

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：18.x 升级指南里 `destructive` → `danger` 那一条迁移说明，原来说「`element:button` 之类直接画 Button 原件的组件保留 `destructive`」，现在改成：`element:button` 本来就写 `danger`、拒收 `destructive`；只有把 variant 原样转给 Button 原件的 `record:quick_actions` 和 `record:alert` 的 action 还收 `destructive`。
- 为什么改：这句话会在下一个 18.x 发版时固化进升级指南。作者照着它在 `element:button` 上写 `destructive`，保存时就被拒；人和读指南的 AI 都会被教错。
- 风险与回滚：只改文字（迁移条目 `reason`、D2 转换的注释、一个测试的用例名），没有任何 schema、取值或转换行为变化；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-page-action-block-variant-destructive-refused.ts`（改的那句）、`packages/spec/src/conversions/page-action-block-variant-destructive-to-danger.test.ts`（新 pin，句子与三处 schema 实测绑定）、`.changeset/27589-action-block-variant-entry-element-button.md`（同版本 changelog 的更正段）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/conversions/page-action-block-variant-destructive-to-danger.test.ts`，应见 41 个用例全绿；把条目文件换回 `origin/main` 的版本再跑，新增的 3 个用例转红。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Before** (`origin/main` `178b5238`), the D3 entry `ui-page-action-block-variant-destructive-refused`, `reason`, L19–L20:

> The blocks now take `danger` and refuse `destructive` with the rename. Other components that draw the Button primitive directly (`element:button` and the like) keep `destructive`, the primitive's own word, and are not touched.

**After:**

> The blocks now take `danger` and refuse `destructive` with the rename. `element:button` already spells it `danger` (`ElementButtonPropsSchema.variant`) and refuses `destructive`, so it is not touched. `destructive` is the React Button primitive's own word; the two record blocks that forward a variant to that primitive unchanged, `record:quick_actions` and a `record:alert` action, still take it and are not touched either.

Measured on `origin/main`:

- `ElementButtonPropsSchema.variant` (`ui/component.zod.ts`) is `z.enum(['primary', 'secondary', 'danger', 'ghost', 'link'])` on a strict object: `danger` parses, `destructive` is refused.
- **The card's wanted wording "no metadata block accepts it" does not hold**, so this PR does not say it. Two record rows still take the primitive's vocabulary on purpose: `RecordQuickActionsProps.variant` and `RecordAlertActionSchema.variant` are both `z.enum(['default', 'destructive', 'outline', 'secondary', 'ghost', 'link'])`, described as "the Button primitive's own vocabulary". The D2 conversion does not visit either type. The corrected sentence names them instead, and the pin asserts both accept `destructive`.

The upgrade guide is generated, not committed (`content/docs/protocol-upgrade/` is git-ignored; the docs build and the release lane run `build-upgrade-guide.ts`). Regenerated locally from this head with `--out` and `--docs`: the protocol 18 page prints the new sentence, and `` `element:button` and the like `` has 0 hits in either output (1 hit each on `origin/main`).

Copies of the same claim, searched in `packages/spec`, `content/docs/**` and `skills/**`:

| Where | Governed | Change |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, the D2 conversion's docblock ("`destructive` stays the Button primitive's word on `element:button` and the other primitive-backed components") | no | corrected to the same facts |
| `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, fixture comment "The Button primitive's own word on another component" | no | reworded to "Another component type: not this entry's, whatever it holds (its own row refuses `destructive`)"; the fixture value is unchanged (prose only) |
| `packages/spec/src/conversions/page-action-block-variant-destructive-to-danger.test.ts`, header bullet and one control label | no | reworded; the control case is unchanged |
| `.changeset/26779-action-block-variant-danger.md` ("`element:button`, toasts, alerts, badges and the like keep `destructive`") | yes (`check-empty-changeset` refuses edits to a changeset the base carries) | not edited; this PR's changeset carries a "Supersedes, in the same release" paragraph |
| `content/docs/**`, `skills/**` | | 0 hits |

The card body of #27243, which quotes the sentence, is the seat's to correct and is not touched here.

## Tests

`page-action-block-variant-destructive-to-danger.test.ts` gains `the D3 entry says what the untouched components accept (#27589)`, which reads the entry from `MIGRATIONS_BY_MAJOR[18]` (the generated chain `build-upgrade-guide.ts` prints) and pins:

- `element:button` accepts `danger` and refuses `destructive`, and the `reason` carries the corrected `element:button` sentence;
- `record:quick_actions` and a `record:alert` action accept `destructive`, and the `reason` carries the sentence naming them;
- none of `reason`, `replacement`, `acceptanceCriteria` matches ``/keeps? `destructive`/`` or contains "`element:button` and the like".

One-shot negative run: with the entry file checked out from `origin/main` and the registry regenerated, the three new cases go red (`Tests 3 failed | 38 passed (41)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 1); restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, blob hash matched HEAD.

No dogfood run: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Acceptance notes

- The conversion's fixture keeps an `element:button` with `variant: 'destructive'` as its "another component type" control. That value is one `element:button`'s own row refuses; it stays because the binding is prose only and the control is still true (the conversion never visits the type). Noted, not changed.
- The 26779 changeset's list also names "toasts, alerts, badges"; those were not measured here and are left as stated.
